title: Karam Singh Leads the Khalsa Charge

blocks.text: The Khalsa now enters the field in its own manner, tying their turbans, fastening their arms, and reciting Gurbani before advancing. Their martial devotion is presented as the real preparation for combat, and they move forward only when spiritually and physically ready.

When the Singhs reach the fiercest section of the line, the clash tightens and the Gilja front resists hard. At that moment Karam Singh of Paijgarh pushes toward the highest concentration of Gilja Pathans, making himself the spearhead of the Sikh assault.

His charge turns the page from anxious waiting into heroic action. Karam Singh rides straight into the thickest danger, and the Singhs behind him begin to convert disciplined preparation into an unmistakable battlefield breakthrough.
